subjectTypes: person with a pet or product and upward visual/action cue
recognizable anthropomorphic subject with upward visual/action cue
firstVisualFocus: central person's colorful head, dark eyewear, and high-chroma outline
spatialSkeleton: upper-left slanted light evidence card plus upper-center dark evidence card; central bottom-bleeding person; high right and low left oversized hand-lettered title
imageTextRelationship: the person points toward two result cards while split large words surround the silhouette and force the eye across the subject
locked: two overlapping cards with contrasting angle and lightness
card edges partially hidden by subject
adaptive: subject identity, clothes and pose content while keeping upward cue
content of the two evidence cards
brand and color values under fixed color roles
forbidden: uniform computer glow replacing hand-drawn outline
copying original identity or interface for another industry

variableContract.person: identity and clothing may change; new subject returns to central near-half-body scale, bottom bleed, and upward gesture/attention cue
variableContract.text: copy may change; prefix remains small and light, main words remain two large opposing vertical blocks with 2-3 glyphs each
variableContract.product: two evidence cards may show other products, steps, or outcomes; their count, angle contrast, overlap, and subject occlusion remain
variableContract.color: exact colors may change; keep warm mid-tone base, dark anchor, high-lightness lettering/dots, cool or contrasting bright focus, and narrow high-chroma outline

invariantContract.layout: subject x14-100%, y30-100%, head center x45-58% y42-51%; light card x2-43% y12-47% at about -30 to -35 degrees; dark card x34-67% y8-34%; right title x70-98% y13-45%; left title x1-27% y41-79%
invariantContract.visualMass: upper about 35%, lower about 65%; visible warm base about 45-55%, dark anchor 20-25%, white/light elements 18-23%, cool bright focus 5-8%, high-chroma outline 2-4%
invariantContract.specialEffects: fine subject cutout, hand-uneven outline thickness 1.5-2.5% of canvas width, irregular white halftone denser next to subject, mild card perspective and shadow, restrained distressed paper background

materialTransformation.action: crop, rotate and perspective on two evidence cards

materialTransformation.trigger: source photo cannot support central bottom bleed
